signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution, ensuring alignment with company goals and customer needs.
Develop a deep understanding of the product, its history, current state, and future opportunities.
Evaluate existing features, workflows, and technical constraints to identify opportunities for innovation, scalability, and growth.
Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, business value, technical feasibility, and strategic objectives.
Identify and champion opportunities involving AI, personalization, collaboration, and other emerging capabilities that enhance the customer experience.
